follows: iteration-27 (commit cf8bc04). Closes the remaining audit tasks p1 (held-out assessment), p4 (freeze) and p5 (corrected scoring primary).
constraints: CPU only, no paid calls. Development landscapes are the same 15; this is leave-one-family-out validation, NOT an independent test set. No prospective unseen landscapes exist yet, and the report must say so.

evaluators.success@B: run evaluates a true global optimum within B distinct evaluations (iteration-26 definition).
evaluators.deployed_probe: prism_search.diagnostics.preflight, best-observed proxy reference, pair/landscape sizes from iteration-27 sizes_for(m=200, size).

A_corrected_scoring_primary.design: Replace the llm_gsm8k_n6 table with experiments/iteration-09/results/llm_landscape_q31corrected.csv (Q31 answer key fixed: 750+430+700+300=2180, so 55 optima, max 1.0). Recompute true rho1 per operator, true operator, true FDC and regime, and success@100/200 for uniform, ls_swap, ea_portfolio, and the protocol at its true budget (40 seeds, seeds 0-39). The corrected table becomes the primary GSM8K landscape in every later analysis; the original is a labelled sensitivity analysis.
A_corrected_scoring_primary.A1: True operator stays insert and true regime stays search_pays after correction.
A_corrected_scoring_primary.A2: The ordering uniform < protocol < ls_swap at B=100 on this landscape is unchanged. Reported per landscape, not pooled.
A_corrected_scoring_primary.A3: Corrected landscape has 55 optima, min 0.0625, max 1.0 (arithmetic check from the audit).

B_heldout.ground_truth: Binary 'search pays' for a landscape = max(success@100 of ls_swap, ea_portfolio) minus success@100 of uniform >= 0.15. The 0.15 margin is fixed here, before any result. Success rates use 40 seeds, corrected GSM8K table for the llm landscape.
B_heldout.probe_decision: Probe predicts 'search pays' for a resample when its estimated FDC <= g. The deceptive threshold d is unused in this binary task. g is fitted on training families only.
B_heldout.protocol: Leave-one-family-out over {llm, neural, sciml, synthetic}. For each held-out family, choose g from {-0.40,-0.35,...,-0.05} (step 0.05) maximizing balanced accuracy of the per-landscape majority probe decision on the other families, ties broken toward the more negative g. Apply to the held-out family. Also report the frozen published g=-0.15 for comparison.
B_heldout.B1: Held-out balanced accuracy of the fitted-g probe does NOT exceed the better of always-search and never-search (both 0.5 balanced accuracy by construction) by a margin whose landscape-bootstrap 95% lower bound is above 0. Expected to hold given 15 landscapes; stated so a null is a pre-registered outcome.
B_heldout.B2_null_calibration: Shuffle each landscape's fitness values across its permutations (seed 20261016 per landscape), keep the marginal distribution, run the deployed probe at m=200 with 200 resamples. Prediction: false 'search pays' rate (FDC <= -0.15) exceeds 10% on average, because the proxy reference includes the best sampled point. Supported if the landscape-bootstrap 95% lower bound exceeds 0.10.
B_heldout.B3_degeneracy: Fraction of probes at m=20 that return FDC exactly -1 (two-point degeneracy from audit M06). Reported only.

claim_rules.no_cherry_picking: All 15 landscapes, all four held-out folds reported, including folds where the fit is undefined because the training set lacks one class.
claim_rules.undefined_folds: If a training set contains a single class, balanced accuracy is undefined for that fold; the fold is reported as undefined and excluded from pooled numbers, with the count stated.
